threat.detail: "Baso": spirits of a colonial love triangle
threat.quote: three friends using a spirit board are possessed by ghosts from a tragic love triangle
a family is terrorized by a possessed killer refrigerator
a teenager courts a woman who is secretly a monster that splits her body in half

origin.quote: The three then partake in the ritual 'spirit of the glass' and summon three spirits
in 1975, a serial rapist murdered his victims and stored their body parts in his refrigerator
the manananggal, a vampiric creature believed to be responsible for murders committed amongst the locals during Holy Week
